verdict.rationale: Railway cloud agents give coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex a persistent remote machine: files stay on the agent's persistent disk and the machine keeps running after you disconnect. That covers the persistent-runtime half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows automatic checkpointing or snapshotting of the agent's state while it works. The 'rollback to any previous version' claim refers to application deployments, not agent environments. Missing for 10: automatic state checkpointing or snapshots of the agent environment, restore-from-checkpoint workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of cloud-agent persistence.
